views.title: iPhone X Fluid Gestures Engine for iPhone 7 Plus (A10)

views.markdown:
### 🚀 Modern iPhone X Gestures on iPhone 7 Plus

Gesture-X is a production-grade rootless jailbreak tweak engineered specifically for Apple A10 Fusion devices (iPhone 7 Plus running iOS 15.0 – 15.8.x) on **Dopamine** and **Palera1n**. It permanently replaces the physical home button navigation with modern fluid iPhone X gestures across every application.

---

### ⚡ Key Features

* **📲 Universal Swipe Up to Home**: Swipe up from the bottom edge in any application (Telegram, Mobile Legends, Safari, etc.) to immediately return to the Home Screen.
* **🎛️ Multitasking & App Switcher**: Swipe up and hold to smoothly open the iOS App Switcher card deck.
* **⚡ Quick App Flicking**: Flick left or right across the bottom edge to instantly switch between recent apps.
* **📊 Top-Right Control Center**: Pull down from the top-right corner of the display to access Control Center.
* **🔔 Top-Left Notification Center**: Pull down from the top-left or top-center to pull down the Cover Sheet.
* **💎 Native Home Bar Affordance**: Sleek bottom pill indicator with optional toggle to hide in games.
* **⌨️ Modern Bottom Keyboard**: Adds bottom padding beneath spacebar with Globe and Dictation buttons.
* **🔦 Lockscreen Quick Actions**: Native Flashlight and Camera quick action buttons on the Lock Screen.
* **⚡ Instant Respring & Proof Banner**: Integrated maintainer script triggers SpringBoard reload upon install and displays an on-screen proof banner!

views.title: Supported Devices
views.text: iPhone 7 Plus / iPhone 7 (A10 Fusion) & all Home-button devices

views.markdown:
**Version 1.0.0**
* Initial release for repository `Gesture-X`.
* Full fluid gestures: swipe up to home, multitasking, quick app flicking.
* Top-right Control Center & Top-left Cover Sheet.
* Lockscreen flashlight & camera buttons.
* Modern bottom keyboard inset.
* PreferenceLoader Settings integration & on-screen proof HUD.
